title: Kiln.World Scale3: the three scale factors of a transform
description: The JSON of Kiln.World's Scale3 (managed/services/Kiln.World/TransformScale.cs; System.Text.Json writes and reads this shape): the factors along the entity's X, Y (up) and Z axes, as World.SetTransformScale takes them (each finite and above 0) and EntityScaleResult reports them. The game's own type is keen::float3, three float32. Docs: docs/kiln/services/world.md.
